dct_description_sm: Filamentary representation of straight segments commonly called “sections” whose digitization is generally done in street centers. A section is then a portion of road with homogeneous characteristics described mainly by the following attributes: the odonym, address ranges and a reference to the boundaries of the former municipalities (ex-cities).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
